teaser: A whiteboard in the hallway still holds last quarter's targets, half-erased. You carry life path 11, a number built around insight that arrives before reason, crossed with ENTJ, a type built to turn any insight into a plan before the ink dries. Stillness is where the 11 does its clearest work; action is where the ENTJ does its clearest work, and in you the two trade off faster than either side can keep pace with. The quiet thing felt in a doorway can become an instruction by the time the door closes. Visitors notice the speed first and the depth under it second, if they notice it at all.
